features: Qlib Alpha158 without VWAP0 (157 features); no substituted VWAP
train_sampling: every fifth trading day from calendar index 65, plus evaluation signals
training_eligibility: dated index member, at least 60 observed bars, positive volume, 20d amount >=50m, finite open-to-open label; ST status not used for fitting
inference_eligibility: same old shared market-only pool intersected with dated index membership; additional ML feature missing values are imputed without removing symbols
label: open[t+6]/open[t+1]-1 (5 trading days), cross-section zscore on each dated training pool
boundary_rule: label exit date strictly before next segment start; no fold updates inside 30d window
preprocessing: training-only medians and median absolute deviations times 1.4826; clip +/-3, missing scaled values to zero; same transformation for Lasso and LightGBM
adaptations: No VWAP: adjusted-price versus raw amount/volume consistency not established
Short local training history, 5-day next-open label rather than original 1-day close label
Shared 25-stock buffered 5-day execution rather than original daily 50-stock TopkDropout
Historical index snapshots are weekly provider updates; not an official daily membership audit
Lasso is fit on training only rather than vnpy example merging train and validation
